title: Affine chart residue triples indexing categories admit an equivalence
statement: theorem etale_chart_residue_triples_equivalence_functor (Y : Scheme.{v}) (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (A : CommRingCat.{v}) (i : Spec A ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i] (xU : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec A) : let x := xU ≫ i let p := (SpecToEquivOfField Ω (Spec A) xU).1 let F := (Spec A).residueField p let e := (SpecToEquivOfField Ω (Spec A) xU).2 letI : Algebra F Ω := e.hom.toAlgebra let K := separableClosure F Ω let χ : F ⟶ CommRingCat.of K := CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap F K) let Nall := (pointSmallEtale x).fiber.Elements let P : ObjectProperty Nall := fun c ↦ IsAffine c.1.left let N := P.FullSubcategory let Q : ObjectProperty N := fun c ↦ ∃ g : c.obj.1.left ⟶ Spec A, g ≫ i = c.obj.1.hom let NU := Q.FullSubcategory let D := (P.ι ⋙ CategoryOfElements.π (pointSmallEtale x).fiber ⋙ Etale.forget Y ⋙ Over.forget Y).op ⋙ Scheme.Γ let DU := Q.ι.op ⋙ D let T := EtaleResidueTriples A p K χ let DT := etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram A p K χ (∀ (c : NU) (z : c.obj.obj.1.left.residueField (SpecToEquivOfField Ω c.obj.obj.1.left c.obj.obj.2.left).1), (SpecToEquivOfField Ω c.obj.obj.1.left c.obj.obj.2.left).2 z ∈ K) → Nonempty (NUᵒᵖ ≌ T)

proof.text: The affine-spectrum construction gives the equivalence of indexing categories; full faithfulness follows by cancellation over the open immersion, and essential surjectivity is obtained by taking the spectrum of each triple.
